lean.statement:
theorem integralDualizing_coefficient_hom_tower_comparison :
    ∃ α : integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower l E ⋙
        CoefTower.totalLimit (integralDualizingCoefficients l E) ⟶
      coefficientDerivedDual (integralDualizingCoefficients l E),
      ∀ C : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
        (integralDualizingCoefficients l E)),
        IsIso (α.app (op C))

proof.text: Resolve the input by a K-flat complex and the quotient tower by one simultaneous K-injective complex. The closed Hom tower is the signed tower of ordinary Hom complexes, and all finite evaluation maps are the actual quotient maps.

The quotient transitions are degreewise surjective. The Roos triangle therefore computes the ordinary inverse limit, and the profinite coefficient tower identifies that limit with the complete coefficient ring. The resulting map is the canonical derived Hom map and is an isomorphism at every input complex.
Transport the comparison through the localization equivalence and use precomposition naturality to obtain one natural transformation with isomorphic components.
